That's clean — no overlap. Quiz-section overlap (mine) is about which TA covers which section; office-hours coverage (yours) is about the Wednesday 16:00-17:00 slot when someone can't hold it. Same neighbourhood, different question, and yours probably needs to come first since it depends on who's assigned. Grading turnaround (mine) and feedback hand-back (yours) are also distinct: mine is the deadline before the section, yours is the mechanism.

So: you take coverage and feedback, I take section assignment and grading deadlines. Shout if that shifts. — John
